conviction_note: The Q3 operating numbers (711 handovers, 701 retail sales, 515 PRS units) were filed on 19 Oct and the 2.94 PLN interim dividend on 27 Oct, so the release adds only the margin, the cash and whether management repeats its FY2026 targets. Hitting the 3.3k sales target now needs a Q4 about 36% above Q3, so the one directional risk is a trim to that target. No consensus is sourced, so every finding is capped small. p_up is 47 on a 3% scale: (2*0.47-1)*3.0 = -0.18. The findings sum to -0.6, larger than the scaled number, because the sum adds small signed proxies while p_up stays near 50 for lack of any sourced bar.

already_public.what: Q3/9M 2026 operating data (current report 25/2026, 17:06). Retail sales: 701 in Q3, 2,005 over 9M. Paid reservations 281. PRS units sold in Q3: 515. Handovers: 711 in Q3 against 413 in Q3 2025, 1,552 over 9M against 1,364.

Interim dividend for FY2026 (current report 28/2026): 2.94 PLN a share, 119.95m PLN in total, record date 25 Nov 2026, paid 30 Nov. The share went ex-dividend on 24 Nov (Yahoo dividend event, close 38.50 to 34.70), before the window opens.
H1 2026 results. Revenue 465.7m PLN (-12%), gross margin 30.6% against 33.3%, net profit 70.1m PLN. Management planned faster handovers in H2.
FY2026 targets: about 3,000 handovers and 3.3k retail sales including reservations. The CEO said Q3 would be better than Q2.
PRS design & build contract for 515 units in Warsaw, 174.9m PLN net. Revenue is recognised over time until 2029.
Financing: a 150m PLN bond at WIBOR+3.5% issued 29 Oct to refinance series 1/2024, and the revolver raised from 100m to 170m PLN on 20 Nov.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 revenue and profit well up y/y (711 against 413 handovers; my estimate is roughly 370-400m PLN revenue and 50-65m PLN net against about 28m PLN in Q3 2025), but that follows mechanically from the pre-released handovers. The swing factor is gross margin, which was 30.6% in H1 against 33.3%. I expect it to stay compressed y/y, in line with peer Dom Development.

Whether the 3,000 handover and 3.3k sales targets are repeated. The handover target needs 1,448 in Q4 (Q4 2025 was 1,285) and looks reachable. The sales target needs about 1,014 in Q4 against about 743 in Q3, so a trim is the more likely change, and it would be negative.
unknown. Land spending of 200-300m PLN is guided for 2026. The 120m PLN dividend falls in Q4, so the Q3 balance sheet will not show it.
Already announced. Nothing new is expected.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 handovers were 711 against 413 in Q3 2025 (+72%) and 585 in Q2 2026. Since Murapol recognises revenue on handover, Q3 revenue and net profit will be up sharply y/y, but the handover count has been public since 19 Oct.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Periodic-report days have been quiet: Q3 2025 (2025-11-18) -0.52%, Q1 2026 (2026-05-20) +0.99%, H1 2026 (2026-09-15) +0.82%. The operating-data releases moved more: 20 Oct 2026 -2.45%, 17 Jul 2026 -2.53%.

findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. It went out as an ESPI report five weeks before the print, and the stock fell 2.45% the next session. All that remains unknown is the margin on those handovers. Sized near zero.
findings.independence: none. This is the company's own filing.

findings.finding: The FY2026 retail sales target of 3.3k including reservations needs about 1,014 net in Q4, after 2,286 over 9M (2,005 contracts plus 281 reservations). Q3 ran at about 743 and Q4 2025 at about 903. The 19 Oct release did not repeat either FY target, so the release or call may trim the sales target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY2025 report with the 2026 targets (2026-04-14) moved +4.51% and +4.07% the next day. The stock rose 6.7% on 27 Oct 2026 on the interim dividend. No observed reaction to a target cut on this name.
findings.original_quote: Łączna sprzedaż do klientów detalicznych w 1-3Q2026 r., z uwzględnieniem opłaconych umów rezerwacyjnych i po wyeliminowaniu rezygnacji, wyniosła 2286. (Total retail sales in 1-3Q2026, including paid reservation agreements and net of cancellations, were 2,286.) The target is from Parkiet, 2026-09-15: 'celem jest sprzedaż 3,3 tys. mieszkań, wliczając rezerwacje' (paraphrased in source).
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public but nobody appears to have published it. Parkiet's 22 Oct sector piece quotes an analyst on 'kolejny kwartał stagnacji w Murapolu' ('another quarter of stagnation at Murapol') without discussing the target, and the share held 37-39 PLN through November. Had a cut been priced, the stock would have fallen into the print net of the dividend, and it did not. This is an inference from company figures, not a company statement, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Parkiet, 2026-10-22, an analyst calls Murapol's Q3 'kolejny kwartał stagnacji': https://www.parkiet.com/budownictwo/art45370971-czwarty-kwartal-w-mieszkaniowce-czyli-sila-rozpedu-i-walka-o-roczne-plany

findings.finding: Gross margin keeps compressing y/y across the sector. Peer Dom Development reported a 9M 2026 gross margin of 31.0% against 34.2% on 19 Nov, and Murapol's own H1 2026 gross margin was 30.6% against 33.3%. Q3 profit on the pre-released handovers is therefore likely to come at a lower margin than Q3 2025.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 2026 report with the margin decline moved +0.82% and then -1.21%. Small.
findings.original_quote: Jednocześnie marża netto obniżyła się z 18,7 do 17,2 proc., a marża brutto ze sprzedaży z 34,2 do 31 proc. (At the same time the net margin fell from 18.7 to 17.2%, and the gross sales margin from 34.2 to 31%.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the trend has been visible since H1. What is left is whether Q3 comes in below the H1 30.6%. It rests on a peer proxy, so it is small.
findings.independence: Murapol's own H1 2026 table, gross margin 30,6% against 33,3%: https://murapol.pl/media/3707765/download/15092026_Informacja_prasowa_sprawozdanie_finansowe_1H2026.pdf?v=1&no-count=1

findings.finding: Financing ahead of the print: the revolver went from 100m to 170m PLN on 20 Nov, a 150m PLN bond was issued on 29 Oct to refinance series 1/2024, and the 120m PLN interim dividend goes out on 30 Nov. What the money buys is the 200-300m PLN of land guided for 2026 (land bank grew from 19.2k to 20k+ units in Q3) plus the payout. It does not look like distress.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to financing lines. The bond and revolver days were flat to slightly negative (20 Nov -0.9%, 23 Nov +1.4%).

findings.why_not_priced: Already public. The land bank growth corroborates investment and the bond margin is unchanged, so neither the price nor the spreads say distress. Signed at zero after asking what the money buys.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, the same sign as the -3.75% run-up lean. But that lean is mostly the 24 Nov ex-dividend drop rather than selling, so the agreement is coincidental. None of the findings is strong enough to beat the free control.
language_note: Every primary fact came from Polish documents on the issuer's own site: current reports 25, 28, 29 and 30/2026 and the Polish press releases. Nothing in English carried the Q3 handover count, the dividend record date, the revolver increase or the PRS recognition schedule.

The session precedent (H1 report at 07:38) and the Q2 PAP consensus came from Strefa Inwestorów. The analyst's 'stagnation' quote and the FY targets came from Parkiet. The peer margin (Dom Development) came from xyz.pl. All are Polish and none appeared in an English source.
English sources (Quartr, stockanalysis, investing.com) carried only undated consensus target prices and no Q3 2026 content.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the handover finding went from +0.3 to +0.1.

'Let the reaction history move p_up, not abs_move_pct' and 'too small about the move': abs_move_pct went from 2.5 to 3.0, the measured base for a pre-released period, and is no longer anchored to this name's quiet periodic-report days (about 1%). p_up is unchanged at 47.
'Financing is a question' and 'cash can outweigh a raised guide': these confirmed the zero sign on the financing finding and added cash flow as a new_in_release line. No size changed.
